chunks: “Whoever we strike with a hadd from the limits of Allah and he dies, then there is no blood money upon us for him. And whoever we strike with a hadd from the limits of the people and he dies, then indeed his blood money is upon us.”

key_terms.حُدُودِ اللَّهِ: the legal limits and punishments that belong to the right of Allah
key_terms.حُدُودِ النَّاسِ: the legal rights and punishments connected to the rights of people
key_terms.دِيَةَ: blood money or financial compensation for a wrongful death

ai.seo_question: When is blood money due if a person dies during the enforcement of a hadd punishment?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal distinction between punishments carried out as the rights of Allah and punishments connected to the rights of people. If death results from enforcing a hadd belonging to Allah’s limits, no diyyah is due, whereas if it results from a punishment tied to the rights of people, the diyyah must be paid.
